title: SchemaComposition
description: A schema node whose validation outcome is computed by applying boolean logic (allOf, anyOf, oneOf, not) to the outcomes of one or more subschemas, rather than by constraining the instance's type, properties, items, length or bounds directly. In code it corresponds to union, intersection, discriminated-variant or negation types built from other data types. Use Reference instead when the node is a single $ref pointer to another schema with no boolean combination; a lone $ref wrapped in a one-element allOf only to attach sibling constraints is still a composition. Use ObjectSchema instead when the structure comes from declared properties, required and additionalProperties on one object, not from merging or choosing among separate subschemas (e.g. a class extending a base is modelled as one object unless the base is a distinct schema combined via allOf). Use SchemaDefinition instead when the subject is the named, reusable entry under definitions itself; a definition whose body is an anyOf/oneOf is a schemadefinition that aggregates a composition. Use StringSchema instead when a set of allowed string literals is expressed with enum or const on one string schema rather than as oneOf over separate subschemas.

allOf.description: All listed subschemas must validate against the instance

anyOf.description: At least one of the listed subschemas must validate against the instance

oneOf.description: Exactly one of the listed subschemas must validate against the instance

not.description: The instance must not validate against this subschema

x-dr-standard: JSON Schema Draft 7 (draft-handrews-json-schema-validation-01) §6.7 Keywords for Applying Subschemas With Boolean Logic (allOf, anyOf, oneOf, not)
x-dr-evidence: A TypeScript union or intersection type alias (type Payment = Card | BankTransfer; type Admin = User & Permissions), or a Python Union[...]/Annotated discriminated union field in a Pydantic model
Serialization polymorphism annotations such as Jackson @JsonTypeInfo/@JsonSubTypes, a Pydantic Field(discriminator=...), or OpenAPI/JSON Schema files containing allOf, anyOf, oneOf or not keys
Validator-library combinators that join other schemas: zod z.union/z.discriminatedUnion/z.intersection/.and(), Joi alternatives().try(), or io-ts t.union/t.intersection
